reason: I make coffee at the office for free, and 3 dinars for a latte is a real chunk of what I earn, so I can't make it a habit. Maybe once or twice a month I'd go with a colleague at my 11am break as a treat, or on payday.
objection: It's just too expensive for me to buy coffee every day when the office one costs nothing. A daily 3 JOD latte would eat a big part of my salary.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap everyday option, like a 1.50 to 2 JOD coffee or a loyalty card for people who work in the complex, would make me come more often.
